info.title: Entra Sign-In Reports BFF - sign-in callback
info.description: IF-2, provided by ST-1 (CMP-2). Keycloak returns the browser here. The __Host-sr_login transaction is opened first and the returned state must match it, for a success and for an error alike; only then is the code exchanged with the PKCE verifier and the ID token's nonce verified, or the failure audited (AD-5).

get.summary: Finish the OIDC authorization code flow

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: OAuth error returned when sign-in did not complete at Microsoft (ST-1 AC-6).

parameters.name: error_description
parameters.description: Only an AADSTS code is taken from it; the free text is never echoed.

302.description: After a verified code: to the returnTo the sign-in started with, setting the session cookie. After a verified error: to /signin/error with the Entra code, an error reference and a UTC timestamp, and a sign-in-failed audit event is written. The login cookie is deleted either way.

Location.description: A same-origin path: the returnTo, or /signin/error?code=<code>&ref=<reference>&at=<UTC instant>.

Set-Cookie.description: __Host-sr_login deleted (Max-Age=0); on success also __Host-sr_session: httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict.

400.description: The login transaction is missing, tampered, expired or answers another state, or the code, PKCE verifier or ID token is refused (type /problems/invalid-login-transaction). No session is created and no audit event is written.
